name: Cybersecurity & Terminal Matrix Workstation
description: Interactive retro/cyber hacker terminal, matrix rain canvas, real-time command parser, and security log analyzer

architecture.html_scaffold:
CYBER_OS v4.2 [SECURE CONNECTION]
System initialized. Type help to list commands.

architecture.css_design_system: body { background: #000; color: #00ff66; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; height: 100vh; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; } #matrixBg { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1; opacity: 0.35; } .terminal-frame { position: relative; z-index: 10; width: 850px; max-width: 95%; height: 520px; background: rgba(5, 10, 8, 0.92); border: 1px solid #00ff66; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,102,0.25); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } .terminal-titlebar { background: #0d1a12; padding: 8px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #00ff66; } .terminal-body { flex: 1; padding: 16px; overflow-y: auto; } input { background: transparent; border: none; color: #fff; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; flex: 1; margin-left: 8px; }
architecture.js_state_machine: const commands = { help: 'Available: scan, status, matrix, clear, date', status: 'All local defenses active. Air-gapped isolation: 100%.', scan: 'Scanning ports... 80: OPEN, 443: OPEN, 8001: AIR-GAPPED.', clear: () => { document.getElementById('terminalBody').innerHTML = ''; } }; document.getElementById('termInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { const cmd = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase(); handleCommand(cmd); e.target.value = ''; } });
